questions.stem: Which folder is the runtime source for approved question content?
questions.correct_explanation: Correct: validated items in data/questions_validated are the approved runtime source.

wrong_explanations.A: questions_raw is draft staging and not runtime-approved.
wrong_explanations.C: docs describe process but are not the question bank.
wrong_explanations.D: app/src contains code, not approved question artifacts.

questions.stem: What is the safest default when changing shared schemas?

options.text: Keep changes minimal and document impact

questions.correct_explanation: Correct: minimal, documented schema edits reduce downstream breakage.

wrong_explanations.A: Frequent undocumented drift breaks validation consumers.
wrong_explanations.C: Skipping checks raises pipeline and runtime risk.
wrong_explanations.D: UI-only updates cause contract mismatch with source data.

questions.stem: After submitting an answer in batch practice, what should the app do next?

options.text: Show explanation feedback, then allow Next

questions.correct_explanation: Correct: feedback should appear before advancing so learners understand outcomes.

wrong_explanations.B: No explanation means no correction loop.
wrong_explanations.D: Resetting state would lose progress and session context.
